name: zinput_global_state_destructor
description: zInput_GlobalState::Destructor drains and deletes the static bind-map overlay free and auxiliary/block node lists, then clears the overlay lifetime fields.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zInput global-state/bootstrap pass.
The current source keeps the original contiguous global-state storage as named globals instead of rebuilding a duplicate aggregate storage mirror.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471a20 repeatedly detaches and deletes nodes from the original free-list field, then repeats the same operation for the auxiliary/block-list field.
Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471a20 clears the auxiliary/block list, free list, reserved field, stack head, and depth fields after deletion while preserving the block-size field.
The native lifecycle smoke verifies deletion of allocated free and auxiliary list nodes, wrapper destructor behavior, field clearing, and block-size preservation.
